frontmatter.title: Decoding Web Performance: A Comparative Study of Base64, Font-Icons, and Embedded SVGs
frontmatter.subheading: Navigating through Different Image Encoding and Embedding Techniques for Optimized Web Performance
frontmatter.excerpt: Unveil the intricacies of web performance through a detailed comparison of Base64, font icons, and embedded SVGs. This in-depth study explores real-world trade-offs, browser behavior, and implementation strategies to help developers build faster, scalable, and visually consistent web applications.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
